method.task_construction: For each TSF series, the final H observations are the test horizon, the preceding H observations are validation, and every full L-step to H-step window wholly before validation is a training example. One test horizon is scored per eligible series; series with no test context or insufficient length are omitted and counted.
method.features: Numeric lag window only; no text, learned embeddings, or recurrent/convolutional/attention modules.
method.normalization: Per-series mean and standard deviation fitted only on raw values before the validation interval; raw-stat calculation uses float64; normalized model tensors are float32.
method.batch: Entire training window matrix is one batch per epoch.
method.training: Repository TabularMLP; Adam 1e-3; MSE; 30 epochs; validation-minimum MSE checkpoint; test used once; CUDA RTX 3050 Laptop 6 GiB.
method.metrics: Macro per-series RMSE and MAE, each normalized by that series training-prefix standard deviation. Baselines are persistence and a frequency-matched seasonal naive where lookback permits.
method.limitations: One chronological split and one seed per architecture; only these 23 variants received difficulty pilots. This is a screen, not a complete vanilla grid, ADP comparison, or runner integration.
